declarations.type:
∀ {now : Nat} (policy : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecyclePolicy)
  (authorizedRenewal : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.RenewalReceipt → Prop),
  policy.expiresAt < now → ¬SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecycleValidAt now policy authorizedRenewal none
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.silence_does_not_renew_expired_feature

declarations.type:
∀ {now : Nat} (policy : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecyclePolicy)
  (authorizedRenewal : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.RenewalReceipt → Prop)
  (receipt : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.RenewalReceipt),
  policy.expiresAt < now →
    ¬authorizedRenewal receipt →
      ¬SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecycleValidAt now policy authorizedRenewal (some receipt)
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.unauthorized_receipt_does_not_renew_expired_feature

declarations.type:
∀ {now : Nat} (policy : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecyclePolicy)
  (authorizedRenewal : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.RenewalReceipt → Prop)
  (receipt : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.RenewalReceipt),
  receipt.issuedAt ≤ policy.expiresAt →
    policy.expiresAt < receipt.newExpiresAt →
      authorizedRenewal receipt →
        now ≤ receipt.newExpiresAt →
          SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecycleValidAt now policy authorizedRenewal (some receipt)
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.authorized_timely_renewal_extends_lifecycle

declarations.type:
SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.oneHopPayloadDetour.graphHops <
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.twoHopBaseline.graphHops ∧
  ¬SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.NoWorse SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.oneHopPayloadDetour
      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.twoHopBaseline
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.fewer_graph_hops_do_not_imply_lower_agent_cost

declarations.type:
SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CertifiedImprovement (SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.localBaselineRoute true)
    (SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.localExtensionRoute true) ∧

      (fun x => True) SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.localBaselineRoute
      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.localExtensionRoute
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.one_owner_improvement_does_not_establish_shared_value

declarations.type:
SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.BoundedExternality SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.unitBudget

      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.boundedButLeaky

declarations.type:
SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.StrictlyBetter SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.uncertainCandidateCost.lower
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.uncertainBaselineCost.lower ∧

      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.uncertainBaselineCost

SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.EvidenceItemsValid (fun x => True)

declarations.type:
(SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.eraseRouterCodeOnly
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.featureDerivedPersistentState).featureEnabled =
    false ∧
  SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.persistentStateSelectsFeatureRoute
        (SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.eraseRouterCodeOnly
          SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.featureDerivedPersistentState) =
      true ∧
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.eraseRouterCodeOnly
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.featureDerivedPersistentState ≠
      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.baselinePersistentState

SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.eraseFeatureCausalClosure
      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.featureDerivedPersistentState =
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.baselinePersistentState ∧
  SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.persistentStateSelectsFeatureRoute
      (SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.eraseFeatureCausalClosure
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.featureDerivedPersistentState) =
    false
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.erasing_feature_causal_closure_restores_baseline_state

declarations.type:
∀ {now : Nat} (policy : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.LifecyclePolicy)
  (authorizedRenewal : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.RenewalReceipt → Prop),
  policy.expiresAt < now →
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.MustErase now policy authorizedRenewal none ∧
      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.eraseFeatureCausalClosure
          SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.featureDerivedPersistentState =
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.baselinePersistentState
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.expired_silent_feature_requires_causal_closure_erasure

declarations.type:
SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.admitCandidateSearchEngine
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine.progressiveGqlLogic none =
  SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateEngineAdmission.blocked
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine.progressiveGqlLogic
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateAdmissionReason.missingCandidateArtifactIdentity

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateArtifactIdentity),
  identity.complete = false →
    SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.admitCandidateSearchEngine
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine.progressiveGqlLogic (some identity) =
      SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateEngineAdmission.blocked
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine.progressiveGqlLogic
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateAdmissionReason.invalidCandidateArtifactIdentity
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.invalid_progressive_identity_is_blocked

declarations.type:
∀ (requested : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine)
  (reason : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateAdmissionReason)
  (engine : SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine),
  ¬SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.SelectsCandidateEngine engine
      (SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateEngineAdmission.blocked requested reason)
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.blocked_candidate_admission_selects_no_engine

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : Option SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateArtifactIdentity),
  (identity = none ∨ ∃ candidateIdentity, identity = some candidateIdentity ∧ candidateIdentity.complete = false) →
    ¬SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.SelectsCandidateEngine
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine.legacyGraphTurbo
        (SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.admitCandidateSearchEngine
          SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.CandidateSearchEngine.progressiveGqlLogic identity)
declarations.name: SearchRouteEvidenceGraphAdmission.progressive_identity_failure_cannot_fallback_to_legacy
